## 5. Example HCL (harness)

```hcl
# Generated by vault-brownfield-codifier
# Capability: teams
# Doc ref: https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs

resource "vault_identity_entity" "admin_synthetic_user_platform_sre" {
  provider = vault.admin
  name     = "synthetic-user-platform-sre"

  metadata = {
    tenant = "platform"
    team   = "sre"
    type   = "synthetic"
  }
}

resource "vault_identity_group" "admin_vault_platform_sre" {
  provider = vault.admin
  name     = "vault-platform-sre"
  type     = "internal"

  member_entity_ids = [vault_identity_entity.admin_synthetic_user_platform_sre.id]

  metadata = {
    tenant = "platform"
    team   = "sre"
  }
}
```

```hcl
# imports.tf - the only file allowed to contain UUIDs
import {
  to = vault_identity_group.admin_vault_platform_sre
  id = "<group uuid from identity.json>"
}
```
